description: Molecular Adverse Outcome Pathway for [AOP 17](https://identifiers.org/aop/17), "Binding of electrophilic chemicals to SH(thiol)-group of proteins and /or to seleno-proteins involved in protection against oxidative stress during brain development leads to impairment of learning and memory".
